create_alexnet_jigsaw_trunk: create an AlexNetJigsaw trunk model registered under the name alexnet_jigsaw for self-supervised visual feature extraction
build_alexnet_forward_pass: build a forward pass through the AlexNetJigsaw trunk that returns intermediate feature maps by specifying out_feat_keys
test_alexnet_feature_blocks: test the AlexNetJigsaw trunk's nine feature blocks including conv1 through conv5, pool layers, and flatten output
register_alexnet_trunk: register the AlexNetJigsaw class as a model trunk using the register_model_trunk decorator with key alexnet_jigsaw
summarize_alexnet_architecture: summarize the AlexNetJigsaw architecture with grouped convolutions, batch normalization, and local response normalization layers
